description: Cool DZ/DAZ paper comparison: published parameters and abundances (never fitted) and the public spectra they are compared with. Abundances are log10 N(Z)/N(He) for host He and log10 N(Z)/N(H) for host H; log_h is log10 N(H)/N(He) (null: pure He).
